description: JavaScript code for Gmail bookmarklet integration with vtiger CRM, including AJAX requests, session management, and UI manipulation.

classes.name: XHR
classes.description: Handles XMLHttpRequest for AJAX calls, supporting both ActiveXObject and standard XMLHttpRequest.

classes.name: VtigerWebservice
classes.description: Encapsulates vtiger CRM web service interactions, including session extension, query, create, and result handling.

methods.name: XHR.load
methods.description: Loads data asynchronously or synchronously via AJAX, with callback support.

methods.name: XHR.readyStateChange
methods.description: Handles ready state change of XMLHttpRequest, invoking callback on success.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.extendSession
methods.description: Extends the session with vtiger CRM via AJAX request.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.create
methods.description: Creates a new record in vtiger CRM via AJAX.

methods.name: VtigerWebservice.query
methods.description: Performs a query operation on vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getGmailSubject
methods.description: Extracts the email subject from Gmail tab title.

methods.name: getVtigerBaseURL
methods.description: Determines the base URL of the vtiger CRM instance.

methods.name: getVtigerURL
methods.description: Constructs the webservice URL for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getGmailURL
methods.description: Gets the current Gmail URL, stripping query and hash.

methods.name: showBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Displays the bookmarklet UI element.

methods.name: hideBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Hides the bookmarklet UI element.

methods.name: destroyBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Removes the bookmarklet iframe and cleans up.

methods.name: showBusy
methods.description: Displays a 'Working...' indicator.

methods.name: hideBusy
methods.description: Hides the 'Working...' indicator.

methods.name: onReady
methods.description: Executes callback when specified DOM element is available.

methods.name: createBookMarkletUI
methods.description: Initializes the bookmarklet UI, including event handlers for search and email creation.

methods.name: getSiblingByTagName
methods.description: Finds the next sibling element with specified tag name.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over objects or arrays, executing callback.

methods.name: findObject
methods.description: Finds an object in array matching a specific value.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Constructs entity name from module details and data row.

methods.name: getEntityEmail
methods.description: Retrieves entity email from module details and data row.

methods.name: displaySearchResult
methods.description: Displays search results in the UI, handling selection and errors.

methods.name: waitForObject
methods.description: Waits until an object is defined before executing callback.

methods.name: setDetails
methods.description: Sets selected entity details into form fields.

methods.name: closeOnSuccess
methods.description: Handles response after creating email record, showing success or error.

methods.name: getTodayDate
methods.description: Returns current date in DD-MM-YYYY format.

methods.name: createEmail
methods.description: Collects form data and creates an email record in vtiger CRM.
